ria: Heads up — I'm prepping the SOC2 packet for the infra team. Quick question: when we roll the RBAC change (reduce cluster-admin usage) do we need to include a separate keystore access snapshot for every service account that loses privilege? I want to avoid duplicating artifacts.

alex: Short answer: yes, include samples for each affected principal type (human, service account, role). But don't need full export for every SA. Sampling policy: 3 per namespace + any SA with elevated perms.

morgan: Also add mapping of RoleBinding -> Subject -> ClusterRole metadata. Auditor asked for proof of "what had access when". We have to show bind timestamp + change author.

ria: Got it. How do we show KMS wrap/unwrap history? auditor asked for key usage logs tied to artifact exports.

samir: We use CloudKMS audit logs (logName=projects/redwood-prod/logs/cloudaudit.googleapis.com%2Fdata_access). You can query with:

```
resource.type=\"k8s_cluster\"
protoPayload.methodName=\"google.cloud.kms.v1.KeyManagementService.AsymmetricDecrypt\"
protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail=\"service-account@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com\"
```

samir: Then correlate with our export job id (export-job=<uuid>) — include that export_job label on the artifact.

ria: Cool. For RBAC snapshots I was thinking of running `kubectl get rolebindings,clusterrolebindings -o json` and attach a sha256. Anyone run into problems with transient subjects (like federated identities)?

alex: Federated identities show up as OIDC principals in `subjects[].name` — include a note in the manifest. For per-request provenance, add the controller manager event from kube-audit.

morgan: FYI, on vuln triage we had a followup: CVE-2025-xxxx affected kube-apiserver auth cache — need to show we patched nodes before the snapshots. Include patch rollout timeline (image tag + kubelet version) in the packet.

ria: Good call. I'll add a timeline CSV: columns date,cluster,image,kubelet,patch-PR. Any preferred format for the auditor?

alex: CSV is fine. Also include a minimal README.md explaining reproduction steps for the snapshot and how to verify the signatures: `sha256sum -c snapshots.sha256`.

ria: One more Q: can we provide redacted logs for user emails? Auditor wants identities but legal wants partial redaction.

samir: We usually provide pseudonymized identity mapping file: real_email -> internal_id in a separate encrypted artifact, decryptable only with auditor key. Include KMS envelope-wrapping metadata.

ops-bot: Reminder: export job 12345 completed at 2025-10-12T15:22:03Z. Artifacts saved to gs://redwood-audit-exports/2025-10-12/rbac-snapshot-12345.tar.gz :white_check_mark:

ria: Thanks — I'll compile and ping once upload ready. tagging @morgan to check timeline CSV.

morgan: Will review tonight, probably push final manifest tomorrow morning :+1:

ria: Closing loop — plan: run snapshot job with export_job=12345, collect KMS logs query, collect kube-audit slice, produce artifacts + README, upload to gs with envelope keys. I'll post final link when done.
